summary: Reproduced the GLM-V bare-placeholder/data mismatch in the checked-out multimodal processor and fixed the OpenAI chat path by neutralizing literal image/video placeholders before template rendering, gated to GLM-V requests that actually contain multimodal input. Structured media, native generate behavior, text-only GLM-V requests, and non-GLM models are unchanged.

remaining_limitations: GLM-5.3-Flash weights were unavailable, so the exact full-model HTTP 500/200 sequence was not run.
The deterministic fixture validates the actual prompt splitting and mismatch path with a stub media decoder; it does not validate GLM model semantics or generation accuracy.

Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37900 was open and unmerged during investigation; this change follows that boundary but adds multimodal-only gating and tool-definition coverage.
